partner.definition:
n. a person who is a member of a partnership
v. provide with a partner
v. act as a partner
partner.translation:
n. 合伙人, 股东, 伙伴, 伴侣
vt. 与...合伙, 组成一对
vi. 做伙伴, 当助手

partner in crime.translation: [网络] 共犯；犯罪同夥；伙伴

partner's equity.translation: [经] 合伙人权益, 合伙人资本

partnered.definition:
v provide with a partner
v act as a partner
partnered.translation: vt. 使合作（partner的过去式与过去分词形式）

partnering.definition:
v provide with a partner
v act as a partner

partnerless.translation: a. 无伙伴的, 无配手的

partners.definition:
n a person's partner in marriage
n an associate in an activity or endeavor or sphere of common interest
n a person who is a member of a partnership
v provide with a partner
v act as a partner
partners.translation: n. 合作伙伴；合伙人；伙伴（partner的复数形式）

partnership.definition:
n. the members of a business venture created by contract
n. a cooperative relationship between people or groups who agree to share responsibility for achieving some specific goal
n. a contract between two or more persons who agree to pool talent and money and share profits or losses
partnership.translation:
n. 合伙, 合股, 合作关系
[经] 合伙(合作)关系, 全体合伙人

partnership accounting.translation: [经] 合伙会计, 合营会计

partnership at will.translation: [法] 不定期的合伙关系, 随意合伙

partnership of marriage.translation: [法] 婚姻的结合, 婚配

partnerships.translation: n. 伙伴关系( partnership的复数形式 ); 合伙人身份; 合作关系
